headline: Bitcoin is holding just above $80,000 on Sunday with no US strike on Iran and no deal so far, after President Trump said either could come soon.

market.asOf: Bitcoin read by this run from Coinbase's bitcoin price page between about 03:55 and 04:30 UTC (10:55-11:30 Bangkok) on Sun 25 Oct. This run could not open CoinGecko or CoinMarketCap, so Ether, Solana and Fear & Greed are not shown. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: Not available this run (source could not be opened)

stories.title: Bitcoin holds just above $80,000 while the US-Iran "strike or deal" question stays open
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell below $80,000 on Saturday after reports of US evacuations from the Middle East, then recovered. President Trump said another US strike on Iran could come "maybe tomorrow", but that a deal was also possible.
points: Coinbase's price page showed bitcoin at about $80,430, down 0.89% over one day, when this run read it (see the time above).
Saturday's low was about $79,280 before a recovery to around $80,138 by 1pm ET, per The Crypto Basic.
CoinGlass data cited by The Crypto Basic shows $436.44M of leveraged bets forcibly closed in four hours, $404.15M of them bets on rising prices.
Trump on a new strike: "We're thinking about doing it, and maybe tomorrow," adding "maybe they'll make a deal," per Arab Times.
Iran's Tasnim news agency called reports of an offer to reopen the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for lifting the US blockade "a lie and fabrication", per ANI.

stories.title: Weekend DeFi hacks: X100 losses rise to about $4.85M, Initia still offline
stories.summary: Attackers used borrowed money to win a voting majority in the X100 protocol's on-chain "Senate" and drained its treasury, and its token crashed. Separately, the Initia blockchain is still paused after a software bug let an attacker create unbacked tokens and move money out.
points: X100: about $4.85M in USDT taken so far plus about 550,000 X tokens, per CryptoTimes.
The X token fell 96.52% to $1.78, per CryptoTimes.
The attack started with a 1,942,457.64 USDT flash loan from Aave, per CryptoTimes.
Initia: about $2.7M moved out before the network was shut down and was swapped into 1,135.52 ETH; a fix plus audit is expected to take several days, per The Crypto Basic.
Initia has announced no restart date, per TokenPost.

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs lost money two days running, but the week still ended up
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, saw money leave on Thursday and Friday. Strong buying earlier in the week means the week as a whole still ended with more money in than out.
points: Friday 23 Oct: -$137.94M, led by BlackRock's IBIT (-$110.34M) and Fidelity's FBTC (-$31.78M), per SoSoValue data cited by The Block.
The week still ended at a net +$304.73M, and total bitcoin ETF assets are $104.43B, per The Block.
Ether ETFs took in $4.35M on Friday but lost $220.60M over the week, per The Block.

briefs.title: Arthur Hayes steps back from directional trades
briefs.summary: Hayes said he closed the directional trades at his family office Maelstrom, selling assets including ETH, ENA and UNI, citing economic and geopolitical worries, per The Crypto Basic.

briefs.title: Electrum wallet urges users to update
briefs.summary: Electrum asked users to install version 4.8.3, saying it fixes a critical security issue, per The Crypto Basic.

briefs.title: Tether says 15 mining firms will build on its open-source mining kit
briefs.summary: They include Bitmain, Bitdeer, Canaan and Foundry, and Tether is aiming for a stable 1.0 release before the end of 2026, per The Crypto Basic.

briefs.title: US spot XRP ETFs had a quiet week
briefs.summary: They took in $4.3M net from 19 to 22 Oct, per 24/7 Wall St, which says lifetime inflows are $1.80B while the funds hold $1.48B.

briefs.title: Railway hosting breach drains crypto wallets
briefs.summary: The cloud host said a third party may have accessed customers' stored secrets; about $371K was drained from more than 200 addresses, per researcher Taylor Monahan's estimate cited by CryptoTicker, and users were told to rotate keys.
